title: The Unfinished Line
style: Country-disco, danceable four-on-the-floor kick with a rounded bass groove, twangy clean electric guitar and pedal-steel flourishes over crisp disco strings and handclaps. Begin with a poised, intimate verse, widen into a bright, bittersweet chorus, then add a brief instrumental steel-and-string break before the final chorus. Expressive adult female lead, warm and self-possessed with a shy, yearning edge; polished, lively mix with clear vocals and subtle harmony layers.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You held your hand beside the painted blue
Explaining all the shapes as if they knew
Your purple sleeve caught every gallery light
I smiled like I was only there for art that night

[Pre-Chorus]
You spoke so calm, the room stood still
I kept my answer folded to my will

[Chorus]
You’re still the picture I can’t turn away from
Still the unfinished line beneath my skin
I leave with everyone, I keep your name some
Quiet little place I never let you in
You smile, I nod, we play our parts so well
But I’m still holding what I couldn’t tell

[Verse 2]
Your silver bracelets chimed against the frame
You asked me what I thought; I said, “It’s brave”
A pale green field, a slash of scarlet red
And all the words I never let be said

[Pre-Chorus]
The bright white walls made leaving look so clean
I took the long way out, unseen

[Chorus]
You’re still the picture I can’t turn away from
Still the unfinished line beneath my skin
I leave with everyone, I keep your name some
Quiet little place I never let you in
You smile, I nod, we play our parts so well
But I’m still holding what I couldn’t tell

[Instrumental Break]

[Bridge]
Maybe you were only being kind
Maybe I made shelter in your eyes
Still, when the door swung wide, I paused
Like one more look could change the cause

[Final Chorus]
You’re still the picture I can’t turn away from
Still the unfinished line beneath my skin
I leave with everyone, I keep your name some
Quiet little place I never let you in
You smile, I nod, I wear my calm so well
And keep the words I couldn’t tell

[Outro]
Under the gallery’s white light
I carried you home in my mind
